event_text: IDNR's Office of Water Resources identifies an apparent cyberattack attempt at the Algonquin Dam
notes: No time of day given in any source we read.

event_text: White House says it sees no indication of a cyberattack behind recent tech outages (does not name the dam)
IDNR announces the incident; CBS Chicago and Shaw Local publish that evening
notes: 10:31 PM ET is Shaw Local's 9:31 PM CST stamp; IDNR's own release time is not known.

event_text: Gizmodo publishes, noting IDNR gave no detail and a spokesperson had not answered questions
